Loss report: forgejo -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.cache: task caches (a task cache has no key or policy; the cache is kept per job and task)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: git resource with source.tag_filter (a tag trigger that also has a branch filter is lost, because one git resource cannot hold both sets)
